master_rule: The approved master is the visual source of truth. Never procedurally redraw or vectorize the mascot as a replacement.

strategy.mascot: transparent high-resolution raster/layered assets derived faithfully from approved master
strategy.future_upgrade: Rive/Lottie or layered frame animation only if it preserves the exact approved appearance

hard_constraints: Do not replace Tuca with Canvas ellipses/paths.
Do not reinterpret the face, eye, beak, feather texture, silhouette or proportions.
Do not use independently generated variants that visually morph between states.
Keep TucaCore state logic unless a bug requires a minimal change.
